correctness.rationale: Proof uses the all-vertices-cycle-or-all-static trace dichotomy on connected graphs, exact two-form petal difference-word classification, modular residue counts, and source-weighted petal multiplication and subtraction of unsupported hub configurations. The tree forcing lemma is proved from leaves. A 98-length integer DP, nine direct local-color enumerations and 15 direct dynamic cases totaling 367,767 configurations with all source-count coefficients checked corroborate critical steps. All scopes are explicit; tests do not replace the uniform proof.

value.rationale: Computes a natural source-resolved recurrent-state invariant on the multi-resonant bouquet family, including arbitrary cycle lengths and attached rooted trees. The coefficient of each source number measures the redundancy of independent resonant loop support at the shared hub. It also gives a sharp existence boundary, the complete orbit count, and invariance under all rooted tree decorations.
